title: Approval of the First Amendment to Contract DA-5749 with D2 (Squared) Industrial Services LLC: To extend the term by two (2) years, for new expiration date of August 8, 2029, and increase the contract
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 10]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the First Amendment to Contract DA-5749 with D2 (Squared) Industrial Services LLC: To extend the term by two (2) years, for new expiration date of August 8, 2029, and increase the contract authority by $1,400,000, for new total not to exceed $1,850,000, covering pipe insulation services for Los Angeles World Airports (Daniel Hughes)
